example.markdown:
# Your Moving Concierge Pack

**Example User** — moving **2026-10-01**
From: 1 Example St
To: 2 Example St

## ⏰ Time-sensitive — do these first

- **Driver's license (California)**: update it after confirming the applicable deadline with the state DMV — https://www.dmv.ca.gov/
- **Voter registration**: https://registertovote.ca.gov/
- **USPS mail forwarding**: check current options and processing times — https://www.usps.com/move/

## ✅ Checklist

### Mail

- [ ] **File your USPS Change of Address** — Forward mail from the old place to 2 Example St for 12 months. Check USPS for its current identity-verification fee, forwarding exclusions, and any service charges; beware copycat sites charging more. — https://www.usps.com/move/
### Driver's license & car

- [ ] **Update your California driver's license / ID** — Check California Department of Motor Vehicles for deadlines and documents for your move type. Moving between states can require an in-person visit. — https://www.dmv.ca.gov/
- [ ] **Update your vehicle registration** — Separate record from your license — skip it and renewal notices keep going to the old address. — https://www.dmv.ca.gov/
### Vote

- [ ] **Update your voter registration** — Check the official election office for registration deadlines, eligibility, and available application methods. — https://registertovote.ca.gov/
### Money

- [ ] **Update banks \& credit cards** — Checking, savings, credit cards — new address on file; order new debit cards if needed.
- [ ] **Update loans \& investments** — Mortgage servicer, auto loan, student loans, brokerage — statements and tax forms follow the address.
### Work

- [ ] **Tell your employer / payroll** — W-2s and any paper checks go to the right place; confirm direct deposit details if your bank changed.
### Tax

- [ ] **Notify the IRS** — File Form 8822 \(free\) so refunds and notices find you. Also update your state tax agency. — https://www.irs.gov/forms-pubs/about-form-8822
### Insurance

- [ ] **Update auto insurance** — Rates are based on where the car sleeps — update on day one to avoid claim headaches.
- [ ] **Update renters / homeowners insurance** — New address, new coverage needs — don't leave a gap.
- [ ] **Update health insurance \& providers** — New address on the plan; find in-network doctors, dentist, and pharmacy near the new place.
### Home

- [ ] **Set up / transfer utilities** — Electric, gas, water, trash — schedule the shutoff at the old place and turn-on at the new one.
- [ ] **Set up internet \& TV** — Book the install appointment before move-in day if you can.
### Deliveries

- [ ] **Update subscriptions \& deliveries** — Amazon, meal kits, magazines, anything that ships to you on a schedule.
### Phone

- [ ] **Update your phone carrier** — Billing address, and check coverage at the new address.
### Health

- [ ] **Transfer prescriptions \& records** — Move prescriptions to a nearby pharmacy; request records from doctor, dentist, and vet.
### Family

- [ ] **Update schools \& childcare** — Enroll the kids, transfer records, update emergency contacts.
### Pets

- [ ] **Update pet microchip \& vet** — Update the microchip registry with the new address and find a new vet.
### Memberships

- [ ] **Update memberships** — Gym, clubs, library card, loyalty programs — the small ones everyone forgets.

---
_Generated by Moving Concierge. This pack gives you the steps and official links — you complete each change yourself. We never file anything on your behalf._
